title: MapleStory Idle RPG Classes and Job Advancement
author: MapleStory Idle RPG Wiki contributors
summary: A class index explaining playable jobs, their skill and mastery trees, advancement milestones, and the relationship between class choice and character progression.

sections.title: Class selection
items: Characters begin as Beginners and choose a class as progression opens.
Each class has its own skills and mastery trees.

sections.title: Advancement milestones
items: Second, third, and fourth advancement milestones unlock new skill tiers.
Prepare the current skill setup before each advancement test.

sections.title: Changing jobs
items: The official FAQ defines the level, advancement, currency, and cooldown requirements.
Review which weapon, appearance, and skill changes follow the switch.

notes: Class availability and advancement details should be checked after major updates.
steps: Review the class skill and mastery pages.
Complete the advancement and rebuild presets.
